idea: Long-shot self-similar family: tile a corner of the unit square with a geometric spiral of squares whose sides shrink by a ratio r (Fibonacci/golden-spiral or a rational approximation). Fill the complementary rectangle with the best uniform grid. Optimise r and the spiral length over rationals so that the total count is n, as a structurally non-lattice candidate.
